headline: Frontline Flare‑Ups Intensify as Casualties Surge
war_summary: Since the early‑morning edition the map has sharpened into a handful of hot sectors. Fishermans Row erupted with seven fresh captures in the past two hours, lifting its daily turnover to twenty‑eight flips and pushing both sides’ loss rates above 170 and 240 per hour while enlistments climb. Dead Lands remains a grinding meat‑grinder, recording two new ownership changes in the last two hours and sustaining >350 casualties per hour for each faction. Linn Mercy, yesterday’s busiest hex, has gone quiet with no flips in the last two hours, though its casualty curves still accelerate near 260 and 280 per hour. Lykos Isle and Clahstra continue to bleed heavily — each exceeding 100 casualties per hour — without territorial movement. Weathered Expanse and Callahans Passage show sharply rising attrition on both sides, yet no base changes. Endless Shore, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and the rear‑area sectors remain static. Overall, base turnover is concentrated in Fishermans Row and Dead Lands, while the bulk of the front bleeds manpower in entrenched, static fights.
